reason: The plugin is primarily an automation utility for in-session operational management within DeepSeek Harness, focused on managing skill definitions and MCP server configuration. Evidence shows it provides explicit tools and slash commands plus a web settings section for inspecting, creating/updating, and removing resources, so the user-facing purpose is session management rather than code generation, testing, or media/document workflows.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话内插件，提供技能与 MCP 服务器的列表、查看、增删改和重载功能，并配套 Web 设置入口用于直接管理会话资源。
summaries.en: This plugin provides in-session management of DeepSeek Harness skills and MCP servers through tools, slash commands, and a web settings area for listing, viewing, creating/updating, removing, and reloading them.

capabilities: Create, update, delete, and inspect skill bundles used by the session
Add, update, reload, and remove MCP server entries with status visibility
Expose session commands and web settings UI for in-session management

reasons.code: README lists skill manager tools for listing, reading, creating, updating, and deleting SKILL.md bundles and visible roots.
README lists MCP manager tools for adding, updating, reloading, inspecting, listing, and removing MCP server configurations.
Package manifest declares a web DSH client entry and patch-based injection, indicating in-session UI/command integration.
